lightly.linePrev: When I rose from a heavy sleep
lightly.lineNext: And I put on my gray suit
stanza: When I rose from a heavy sleep
And I put on my gray suit

rightly.linePrev: Time will tell if I can be well
rightly.line: And rise to meet you rightly
stanza: When I called you, you little one, in a bad way
Did you love me, do you spite me?
Time will tell if I can be well
And rise to meet you rightly

tightly.songTitle: I Am Trying to Break Your Heart
tightly.linePrev: What was I thinking when we said hello?
tightly.line: I always thought that if I held you tightly
tightly.lineNext: You would always love me like you did back then
stanza: I always thought that if I held you tightly
You would always love me like you did back then
Then I fell asleep in the city, kept blinking
What was I thinking when I let you back in?
